'''Thavrin''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Pelugrotoa]], a major economy of [[Mahea]] and the fourth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city had a population of 14,838,000 at the [[Pelugrotoa|Pelugrotoan]] 1764 census, ranking it the [[List of cities and dependencies by population|sixteenth-largest city in the world]] by population. Thavrin will host the [[1772 FLLA World Cup]], the first FLLA World Cup to be held in [[Pelugrotoa]] under the FLLA's confederation rotation framework.
